_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What ToolBox does and the usual update routine.
ToolTips.Tools: Every tool's Lite EXE - the sealed build, which asks for the user or admin password.
ToolTips.Developer: Source version vs built EXE for every tool; build them here.
ToolTips.Update: Bring the tools' source up to date from a GitHub zip (or git pull), then build.
ToolTips.Tools > Launch: Start the selected tool's Lite EXE (the sealed build; it asks for the user or admin password). Double-click a row does the same.
ToolTips.Tools > Open folder: Open the selected tool's folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Tools > Refresh: Look at the projects folder again (new tools, new builds).
ToolTips.Developer > Build selected: Run Build-App.cmd for the selected tools, one at a time: <Name>Dev.exe, and <Name>Lite.exe with the passwords asked once. Running tools are skipped.
ToolTips.Developer > Build all: Run Build-App.cmd for every tool, one at a time: <Name>Dev.exe, and <Name>Lite.exe with the passwords asked once. Running tools are skipped.
ToolTips.Developer > Stop: Let the tool being built finish and skip the rest.
ToolTips.Developer > Launch developer EXE: Start the selected tool's developer build, <Name>Dev.exe (Update, Build Lite, Extract, Version History).
ToolTips.Developer > Open folder: Open the selected tool's folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Developer > Refresh: Read the versions and build times again.
ToolTips.Update > Open zip: Pick a zip of the admin-tools repository downloaded from GitHub. It is unpacked into AppData and compared - nothing changes yet.
ToolTips.Update > Apply update: Replace each tool's source with the zip's (the old source is kept in _Backup), then build all if ticked.
ToolTips.Update > Build all after the update: On: as soon as the update is applied, every tool is built (the Lite passwords are asked first, once).
ToolTips.Update > Pull (git): This folder is a git clone: get the latest source from GitHub (git pull). Then Build all on the Developer tab.
ToolTips.Build > Also build the Lite EXEs (the se: On: each build also makes <Name>Lite.exe, sealed with the passwords below. Off: developer builds only.
ToolTips.Build > Build: Start the builds with these passwords.
